summary: Frontend testing of Room Setup Templates feature - Create Template and Save as Template functionality. All requested features verified working: Templates tab, Create Template button/dialog, Save as Template (Sparkles) button on room cards, Save as Template dialog. Found one bug: duplicate system templates appearing in the list.

minor.issue: Seed system templates endpoint is called on every template fetch, causing duplicate template_id entries to appear in UI (tpl_sys_wedding, tpl_sys_corporate, tpl_sys_gala appearing twice each)

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate system templates displayed (Boda Clásica x2, Conferencia Corporativa x2, Gala de Premiación x2)
ui_bugs.cause: React key collision - same template_id being used for multiple items
